mostWorthwhile.text: The collecting-duct construction was most worthwhile: its planned picture connects ADH receptors and additional water channels to water movement toward more concentrated surrounding tissue and back into blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the hormone route to the body was comparatively repetitive after the separate route had just been built, although it connected the example to the larger model.

surprise.text: The sensors led directly to ADH in the blood, before the separate nerve-ending-to-capillary route was assembled; that transition was quicker than expected.

arbitrary.text: Building the release route separately after ADH had already appeared in the blood felt slightly out of sequence, even though the later picture clarified its purpose. ADH was also not expanded by name in the supplied chapter.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the water-channel and feedback comparisons made the system connections interesting, though I would hope for less repetition between separate examples and the body model.
